Description: OntoKSD competency framework (subset) focused on automata and formal models. Default scale: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Expert.

Short name: Competence: Develop problem solutions using Automata
Description: Ability to design, construct, and validate automaton-based solutions for well-defined computational problems. Interpret requirements and model behavior using automata, applying formal methods to ensure logical consistency and operational correctness.
Design states and transitions to represent system functionalities- foundational for modeling automata-based solutions.
Construct, develop, and design automata-based models for target problems (Bloom: Creating).
Interpret and document system requirements- map specifications to automata behavior.
Interpret, implement, and organize requirements into automaton models (Bloom: Applying).
Decompose problems, evaluate constraints, and plan robust automata-based solutions.
Apply analytical and critical thinking to align user requirements with technical feasibility and optimize computational resources (Bloom: Applying).
Collaborate effectively in team-based design, implementation, and validation of automata.
Act responsibly, documenting decisions and ensuring model correctness and traceability.
Proactively refine models, address edge cases, and seek improvements in robustness.
Demonstrate creativity by exploring alternative designs and extensions when appropriate.
